title: Taboo Game · Deterministic Multiplayer
description: *Taboo* is a **party game web app** for playing the classic word-guessing game across several phones in the same room — **no server, no rooms, no realtime sync**. Every device reconstructs the full game state from a shared seed and turn number agreed verbally.

Built **100% by an AI coding agent** under my direction. A **seeded mulberry32 PRNG** with **FNV-1a hashing** drives a deterministic **Fisher-Yates** shuffle with a per-turn slot budget, so a card from a previous turn can never come back. The 1100+ card Spanish deck was generated by **dozens of parallel AI agents** across many themes.
Shared state lives in URL query params for one-click invites; personal info stays in localStorage. The deterministic logic is **fully TDD-covered** with Bun's test runner.
